title: fix(app-shell): DefaultRegisterPage moves a signed-in visitor on instead of an empty layout (objectui#11714)
body:
Fixes #11714

Clause-②: no

The page moves a signed-in visitor on instead of rendering an empty layout. No export, prop, type member or i18n key is added, and no accepted input widens. The emitted declaration of `DefaultRegisterPage` keeps its `JSX.Element` return type, read from the rebuilt `packages/app-shell/dist/console/auth/RegisterPage.d.ts` at `2558521`; only its doc comment gains a paragraph.

## What was wrong

Measured over a real `AuthProvider` with a signed-in session at base `a58626c`, before any edit, with a throwaway probe that was not committed:

- `invite_only`, an owner, signed in: the page stays on `/register` showing an empty `AuthPageLayout`, and nothing changes it. No bootstrap probe is made. This confirms the card.
- `open`, signed in: the page renders the sign-up form to the signed-in user.
- `invite_only`, signed out: the by-invitation notice (control).

The probe was gated on `!user`, so for a signed-in visitor the offer stayed `pending`, and `pending` renders the empty layout.

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` (`DefaultRegisterPage`):

- The page latches the moment the first session check answers. `isLoading` is raised again by every sign-up in flight, so the latch is what keeps the form, and the refusal it holds, mounted during a submit. The console's own register page latches it the same way.
- Signed in: the page returns react-router's `Navigate` element to `/` with `replace`, before any offer logic. `/` is where the page already sends a visitor after a successful sign-up (`RegisterForm`'s `onSuccess`, unchanged). It does not wait for the config or the probe.
- Until the session check answers, the page renders its existing empty placeholder and offers nothing, and the probe runs only for a visitor known to be signed out. So a visitor who turns out to be signed in is never shown the form first.
- The `disableSignUp` bounce to `/login` now applies only to a signed-out visitor, so a signed-in one goes to `/`, never to `/login`.
- `decideSignUpOffer` and `DefaultLoginPage` are unchanged.

`packages/app-shell/README.md`: the sign-up table gains a "signed in" row. The `useSignUpOffer` example latches the session check, probes only for a signed-out visitor, and answers `signed-in` for a signed-in one, so its return type is `SignUpOffer | 'signed-in'`. A sentence after it says a host moves that visitor on.

`.changeset/11714-register-signed-in-visitor.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Pins

`packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/registerSignedInVisitor-11714.test.tsx` renders the exported page over the real `AuthProvider`, `createAuthClient` and `I18nProvider`, with only `fetch` stubbed. A MutationObserver records every form or notice the page mounts, so a flash that lasts one commit still counts.

1. `invite_only`, an owner, signed in: settles on `/` by REPLACE with no auth layout left, nothing offered, zero probes.
2. `open`, signed in, with the session answer held until after the config read: nothing offered while it is held; after release it settles on `/`, with nothing ever offered.
3. `disableSignUp: true`, signed in: `/`, never `/login`.
4. Control: signed out, the same late session: stays on `/register`, shows the notice, and is probed only after the session answers.

objectui#11705's page pins (`defaultPagesFollowPosture-11705.test.tsx`, 11 cases) and the decision pins (`signUpOffer-11691.test.ts`) are byte-unchanged and green, as is `signUpOffer.ts`.

## Ablation (one leg, from committed HEAD `2558521`)

The signed-in line (the `if (user) return` of the `Navigate` element) was deleted through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `683d5700` to `b12a7137`), with a trap restore.

- Predicted: cases 1 to 3 red; the control and the 11 objectui#11705 cases green.
- Observed: `Tests 3 failed | 12 passed (15)`. All three fail on `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="home"]`, so the page stayed on `/register`.
- Restore: blob after restore equals the HEAD blob `683d5700335b`, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.
- The test imports the page by relative path from `src`, so there is no `dist/` leg.

A second one-shot leg proves that `check:doc-snippets` compiles the README block. Changing `'signed-in'` to `'signed-inx'` in the example gave `TS2820: Type '"signed-inx"' is not assignable to type 'SignUpOffer | "signed-in"'` in the app-shell README's `useSignUpOffer` block, with `782 of 782 block(s) judged, 1 failed`. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD `c5c91ce18545` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

NOT MEASURED: the whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`). Reason: it was killed at a 500 s foreground timeout (exit 124) before it printed a verdict, so it is left to CI's `pnpm test` shards. The local narrowing rests on two readings. First, every test that names `DefaultRegisterPage` or imports `../RegisterPage` lives in that `__tests__` directory (`git grep`); the `apps/console` tests that match `auth/RegisterPage` import the console's own page, not this one. Second, the page's emitted declaration and the package's exports are unchanged, so no importer's typing moves.

## Acceptance notes

- After a successful sign-up, two moves can now both run, depending on which comes first: `RegisterForm`'s `onSuccess` pushes `/`, and the signed-in branch replaces with `/`. Measured once in the test DOM, only the REPLACE showed. Either way the visitor lands on `/`. Not filed.
- `DefaultLoginPage` does not single out a signed-in visitor: it renders the sign-in form. The card covers the register page only. Read from source, not filed; carrier: none.
- The `Navigate` element renders nothing while it navigates. `chrome/RedirectWithSplash.tsx` documents the blank window that leaves on the console's boot path. Here it follows the page's own empty placeholder. Read, not measured; not filed.
